title: Patch v0.3.16: the Human tag on Clip-Farming Critikal, Medina Outfitter, Medina Enforcer, Playtester and MC Tech
notes: Tags classic-040, meditative-057, meditative-082, meditative-083 and meditative-085 Human, a designer's decision; no text, stats, cost or rarity change. Meditative-057 was already claimed by pending v0.3.10 when this patch was made, and a card ships in one patch, so its Human tag ships under that patch's claim (R1280000); this note's player lines still describe it.
